name: sweep is seeded and preserves requested order
test:
first = double_descent_sweep(12, 18, [1, 15, 4], noise_std=0.05, seed=7)
second = double_descent_sweep(12, 18, [1, 15, 4], noise_std=0.05, seed=7)
assert first == second
assert [row[0] for row in first] == [1, 15, 4]

name: under and over parameterized fits stay finite
test:
import numpy as np
rows = double_descent_sweep(10, 25, [2, 10, 20], seed=9)
assert all(np.isfinite(value) and value >= 0 for _, train, test in rows for value in (train, test))

name: width order and repetition reuse one data draw
test:
import numpy as np
first = double_descent_sweep(8, 15, [2, 12, 2], seed=31)
second = double_descent_sweep(8, 15, [12, 2], seed=31)
assert first[0] == first[2] == second[1]
assert first[1] == second[0]
assert first[1][1] < 1e-16, 'wide full-row-rank least squares should interpolate'
